name: multilingual_check
description: Translate text into another language (or respond in it) using Wren's OWN local model (qwen2.5:14b via localhost Ollama) — fully offline, no external provider, zero cost. Returns an HONEST confidence tier plus a fallback note when the model is out of its depth. Confidence tiers are grounded in a real measured assessment (2026-07-30): HIGH for French/Spanish/German/Russian/Chinese/Japanese/English (+documented it/pt/ko), MEDIUM for Arabic/Hebrew/Dutch/Polish/Turkish/Vietnamese/Thai/Indonesian (usable but verify), LOW for Hindi/Welsh/Swahili/Zulu and any untested language (measured failure -> do NOT ship as authoritative, route to gene pool or a human). Use whenever Wren must read, translate, or reply to non-English text so she states honestly what her model can and cannot handle.

text.description: Source text to translate, or the request to answer when mode=respond.

target_language.description: Language name or ISO code, e.g. 'French' or 'fr'.

timeout.description: Wedge-aware: the local model may cold-load or be mid wedge-heal restart.

authored_by: Claude for Wren (additive skill — Ross A4 multilingual capability, 2026-07-30)
